title: allMutationCommands must stay a function (import cycle); _clients stack is spliced by identity, never popped
answers: Why is allMutationCommands() a function instead of a module-level constant array?
Why can't the mutation client list use client.pop() on deactivation?
Safe pattern for removing a document's mutation client when multiple documents are mounted at once
body: `commandRegistry.ts:allMutationCommands()` is deliberately a function, not a module-level array: eagerly reading `DASHBOARD_COMMANDS`/`NOTEBOOK_COMMANDS` at import time would run into a real cycle (dashboard command → PanelMenuBehavior → extensions registry → RestrictedGrafanaApisProvider → dashboardMutationApi → commandRegistry). Converting it back to a constant reintroduces the cycle. `dashboardMutationApi.ts` keeps mounted clients in a stack (`_clients`), not a single slot, because more than one document can be active at once (e.g. a notebook rendered outside the notebooks route over a dashboard). On deactivation it must remove the specific client by identity (`lastIndexOf`/splice), not `pop()`, because deactivation order across documents is not guaranteed to be LIFO.
applies: Applies to public/app/features/plugins/components/restrictedGrafanaApis/dashboardMutation/{commandRegistry.ts,dashboardMutationApi.ts}; unrelated to the alerting restricted API.
